findings.text: follow-on: the head arm's first line names revision fd667e1c (the base) while the arm measured the working tree carrying the fix at 0b2abbfd; the log's correction line and the manifest's artifacts both restate the true revision, but a reader keying on the header alone attributes the passing head arm to the wrong commit.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against fd667e1c; 0b2abbfd guards _worktree_untracked_paths (+9/-1) and adds the 237-line test module, c7cbffd adds the s10 landing fragment, and nothing lands outside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the pre-fix reproduction, the guard, and base and head arms with zero added failures; the run records repro-prefix.log (TypeError at promotion.py:640, EXIT=1), gate-head.log (2 passed, EXIT=0), base-base-arm.log and base-head-arm.log (both 59 passed, EXIT=0, no FAILED/ERROR id) and negative-control.log (1 failed, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a commitless run whose registered worktree directory was removed while git still lists it reconciles from what survives instead of crashing; reckon/crew/promotion.py:640 now returns the empty tuple when the untracked listing is unreadable, so the promotion emits a JSON payload rather than raising.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commits 0b2abbfd and c7cbffd, the four gate logs, measurement_module and measurement_cwd for the scratch arm, the negative control and its failing id, and states the run is not armed so baseline_suite and after_suite carry no record.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_a_vanished_worktree_reads_as_no_referent.py, the s10 evidence fragment and a figures directory; every path in the two commits sits inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_vanished_worktree_reads_as_no_referent.py::test_a_commitless_promotion_reads_a_vanished_worktree_as_no_change fails with TypeError at promotion.py:640 when the guard is removed, as negative-control.log shows, so the assertion names the regression it catches.
justifications.evidence: the reproduction, gate, both arms and the negative control are recorded in logs the manifest names, but the manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite record and the head arm's log header names fd667e1c while it measured the fix tree, so the header alone mis-attributes that arm.
justifications.fit: the None-to-empty reading at promotion.py:640 matches _worktree_repository_changes' documented contract that an empty result is the only condition permitting a commitless promotion, and introduces no name the naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: promotion.py:640 returns the empty tuple for both an absent and an unreadable listing, so a vanished worktree no longer raises and the run reconciles, which is the stated goal.
justifications.scope_discipline: the two commits touch only reckon/crew/promotion.py, tests/test_a_vanished_worktree_reads_as_no_referent.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner/a-vanished-worktree-reads-as-no-referent.html, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
